item.description:
1.6.0

  • Settings is now a native macOS-style window with General, Storage, Credits, and About panes
  • Sidebar selection uses a soft neutral highlight instead of green, and Home has a new olive badge
  • Book covers rest on the page with a natural shadow, and Rating / ISBN / Cover are grouped together

1.5.5

  • Carry forward up to the last 10 versions of release notes inside appcast.xml's <description><![CDATA[...]]></description> via a new scripts/release-notes.sh helper so users who skip versions see all intermediate release notes directly inside Sparkle's update alert.
  • Render the latest version at the top under <h3 style="margin: 0 0 6px 0; font-size: 13px;"> and style carried-forward prior versions under <h3 style="margin: 14px 0 6px 0; font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.75;">, wrapping headerless legacy <description> blocks with their <sparkle:shortVersionString> heading and backfilling from recent GitHub Releases.
  • Emit <sparkle:fullReleaseNotesLink>https://github.com/dgattey/saga/releases</sparkle:fullReleaseNotesLink> in scripts/generate-appcast.sh (and pass --full-release-notes-url to Sparkle's generate_appcast binary when supported).

1.5.4

  • Tighten sidebar spacing between the search bar, Home row, and Books list
  • Keep sidebar selection pills visible with a solid botanical tint backing layer
  • Replace continuous 30Hz scroll-velocity timer polling with native scroll geometry tracking

1.5.3

  • Compute release version and Sparkle build number at merge time instead of committing version bumps to PR branches, eliminating project.pbxproj merge conflicts across parallel PRs

1.5.2

  • Fix Sparkle update signature validation so macOS updates install cleanly without signature verification errors
  • Require and cryptographically verify sparkle:edSignature against SUPublicEDKey during release packaging
  • Pin ad-hoc signed app bundles to a bundle-identifier designated requirement (designated => identifier "com.dylangattey.Saga") so Sparkle's code-signature check succeeds across builds

1.5.1

  • Restored floating transparent window toolbar & clean sidebar backdrop: Removed .backgroundExtensionEffect() from the detail Group and restored #if os(macOS).toolbarBackgroundVisibility(.hidden, for:.windowToolbar) #endif. On macOS 26 Tahoe, .backgroundExtensionEffect() on the detail column clips the primary view to the safe area (exposing a solid white toolbar bar across the top of the detail pane) while projecting a blurred mirror reflection of adjacent book covers into the sidebar column and toolbar safe areas.
  • Rebalanced Home sidebar item proportions: Enlarged the Home row on both macOS and iOS with a 36×36pt rounded rectangle botanical badge inside a 42pt icon column (matching book cover column alignment), books.vertical.fill icon (16pt semibold), .title3.weight title typography, and a 48pt row height (padding(.vertical, 6)), giving it proper HIG visual weight next to the 64pt 2-line book rows.
  • Eliminated per-frame SwiftUI view invalidations during scrolling:
  • Replaced @State properties mutated on every scroll geometry tick (lastOffset, lastTimestamp, isPaused, isRestoring, didNotifyRestore) with non-reactive reference state holders (ThrottleState and ScrollLifecycleState) and bucketed onScrollGeometryChange triggers so scrolling no longer invalidates the entire ScrollView subtree on every display frame.
  • Replaced @Binding var entry: NavigationEntry? in HomeBookThumbnailView with an onSelect: (NSManagedObjectID) -> Void callback and a vector shadow backdrop so cells don't re-evaluate or rasterize alpha-composited image shadows during scroll.
  • Synchronous memory-cache hits & background image decoding:
  • Added kCGImageSourceShouldCacheImmediately: true and kCGImageSourceShouldCache: true when loading disk-cached PNGs so bitmap decompression happens on the .utility background queue instead of blocking the main thread on first render.
  • Passed explicit targetSize in BookListPreviewView to bypass GeometryReader async measurement passes in sidebar cells, and avoided redundant @State mutations in DownsampledAsyncImage when an image is already in memory cache.
  • Replaced heavy .glassEffect() loading placeholders inside grid cells with lightweight RoundedRectangle fills.

1.5.0

  • Redesigned Settings on macOS with a split sidebar layout (General, Storage, and Credits & About) and Liquid Glass cards.
  • Added a Credits & About pane with quick links (Website, GitHub, More by Dylan), Data & APIs attributions, and Open Source Libraries with version and license badges.
  • Added a Settings button on iOS to adjust cache limits, spring animations, and view credits in an adaptive sheet.

1.4.3

  • Check for updates automatically when launching Saga on macOS (SUEnableAutomaticChecks and checkForUpdatesInBackground()).
  • Render in-app Sparkle release notes as clean, scannable bullet lists instead of unformatted Markdown paragraphs.

1.4.2

  • Added the saga.gattey.com macOS download site with a collapsible System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway first-launch guide.
  • Improved macOS app bundle signing and portable framework runtime paths (LC_RPATH) for cleaner launches after download.
  • Connected saga.gattey.com/download/macos to the live Sparkle release feed so new updates are available immediately.

1.4.1

  • Switched CI and default non-Developer-ID macOS release signing in scripts/lib/signing.sh, scripts/package-release.sh, and .github/workflows/release.yml from a self-signed X.509 certificate (SAGA_CODESIGN_P12_BASE64) to ad-hoc (-) signing so quarantined release downloads work cleanly with macOS Sequoia / Tahoe's Privacy & Security → Open Anyway flow without syspolicyd / amfid rejecting an untrusted X.509 certificate chain (CSSMERR_TP_NOT_TRUSTED) when loading @rpath frameworks (Sparkle.framework, Ifrit.framework).
  • Added com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation and com.apple.security.network.client (<true/>) to Saga/Saga/Config/Saga.entitlements (matching GatteyPhotos.local.entitlements) and required --entitlements when signing Saga.app in scripts/package-release.sh (with ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX=NO during CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO builds).
  • Updated release packaging comments in scripts/package-release.sh, scripts/lib/signing.sh, and scripts/export-ci-secrets.sh to document ad-hoc (-) + Sparkle 2 EdDSA update verification.
